stem: A coworker asks a technician to sign a sanitation record for work the coworker performed. What is the best response?
choices: Do not attest to work not personally performed or verified under the authorized process
Sign it because both workers were on the same shift
Sign only if the task was probably completed
Use initials so the signature is less formal
rationale: Records should accurately identify who performed or verified the work according to the established process.
